- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course Title: "Language, Form, and Everything in Between"
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course Description: Explores the relationship between language and form, examining how language shapes perception and how forms communicate ideas, emotions, and messages.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 1 Content: Introduction to Language and Form, including a lecture, discussion, and activity analyzing visual and linguistic forms in art.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 2 Content: Language and Perception, covering the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, discussions on language's influence on perception, and activities exploring this relationship through writing and visual art.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 3 Content: Forms and Structures in Art and Design, including lectures, discussions, and activities analyzing works of art and design.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 4 Content: Language and Architecture, focusing on how language influences building design and activities analyzing linguistic and visual forms of architecture.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 5 Content: Forms and Communication in Advertising and Marketing, including lectures, discussions, and activities analyzing advertisements.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 6 Content: Forms and Expression in Literature and Poetry, with lectures, discussions, and activities exploring different literary forms.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 7 Content: Forms and Culture, discussing the relationship between forms and cultural values, with activities analyzing cultural artifacts.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 8 Content: Final Project where students create a project exploring the relationship between language and form in a chosen context.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assessment Breakdown: Class participation and attendance: 20%, Weekly assignments and activities: 40%, Final project: 40%.
